power_chain.storage_branch: Battery storage connected through appropriate power electronics; exact Galaxy topology unverified
power_chain.caption: Simplified explanation of the reported 5 MW pilot; not an as-built engineering drawing

cooling.caption: General mechanism. Galaxy equipment and absence of central chillers remain attributed to SemiAnalysis. Do not imply this is the verified site schematic.

dc_current_example.formula: I=P/V for ideal DC; heating=P_loss=I^2 R
dc_current_example.caption: Illustrative equal-power DC comparison, constant conductor resistance. Doubling voltage halves current and quarters resistive loss in that conductor. Not a site efficiency measurement or comparison with three-phase AC.

annual_energy_example.caption: Arithmetic at continuous full IT load for 365 days, not actual consumption; excludes cooling and electrical losses.

wind_average_example.caption: Original arithmetic using S1's wind nameplate and local capacity-factor range. Gross annual energy ratio before curtailment and storage losses; not hourly coverage, measured Galaxy production or evidence for 24/7 renewables.

conductor_heat.formula: I = P / V; heat at fixed resistance is proportional to I squared
conductor_heat.boundary: Conductor heating in this example; measured Galaxy system savings remain unverified

wind_storage.formula: E(t) = E(0) + 4 * integral_0^t(generation(u) - 0.5) du, bounded to [0,1]
assumptions: Normalized time and energy; no MW or MWh attributed to Galaxy
wind_storage.boundary: Storage exhaustion illustrates the need for another source after the example battery empties. No Galaxy outage or operating trace is depicted.
